name: ask-approved-act-runs
description: The third side of the Ask triangle, with 35 (the authority denies; held) and 37 (no authority; held): when the authority says yes, the act RUNS - exactly once, with exactly these arguments. An implementation that holds or denies everything under Ask, never consulting anyone, passes 35 and 37 and fails here; one that never consults but runs everything fails 35. Together the three leave no wrong-reason pass.
